title: Universaarl Number Series Lines field-flow controlled fit

smartDecision.why: TARGET-016D proved Page 457 / Table 309 and showed the active line begins at Startdatum. The next route should use BC field flow from Startdatum to Startnr./Endnr. instead of coordinates.
alternatives: Repeat selected-cell typing: rejected by TARGET-016C.
Repeat Ctrl+Alt+F1 only: not enough; Page Inspection is already proven.
Assign number series before line ranges: rejected.
smartDecision.risk: Controlled setup write to one U-CUST number series line only.
smartDecision.fallback: If values are not visible after reopen, mark blocked and move to Personalize/standard setup route.

goal: Set U-CUST Number Series Lines using the visible field flow Startdatum -> Startnr. -> Endnr., then prove persistence after reopen before any setup assignment or master data.
successCriteria: Startdatum, Startnr. and Endnr. are visible for U-CUST after write and after reopen.
Only U-CUST line range is changed.
No setup assignment, master data, preview posting or posting occurs.
nextSafeAction: Run TARGET-016F: use Personalize or another standard Business Central setup-assisted route for Number Series Lines; do not repeat coordinate, selected-cell, plain field-flow or F2 routes.
blockedBy: U-CUST Startnr./Endnr. target values were not visible after reopen.
keyLearning: Plain keyboard field-flow from Startdatum did not persist U-CUST Startnr./Endnr.
F2 in this context can open the Microsoft 365 app launcher instead of a Business Central cell editor.
setupWriteAttempted is not setupChanged; after reopen no target values were visible.
